# Distinguish formatter text from encoded bytes

The formatter returns a string, not bytes. Verify encoded bytes explicitly with Buffer.from(text, 'utf8') rather than describing text as already encoded. The baseline probe is recorded in [the observed output](../testing/formatter-probe.md). Do not claim that any spreadsheet application was tested. Scope: this Node formatter and its declared encoding; no external consumer evidence.
